# Not Another Event

> Not Another Event builds event planning software and custom event systems. Tagline: "Making events simpler and a lot more fun."

## What we do
- Event platform: guest lists, payments, seating plans and DJ requests in one place.
- Custom event systems built around how a client's events actually run.
- Ongoing support and updates.

## Who it's for
Organisers of weddings, corporate events, parties, conferences and community events.

## How to work with us
Submit the form at https://notanotherevent.com/#contact (includes an optional budget). A team member replies by email, usually within one business day.
